---
name: RFC — design change
about: Use when a change touches a principle (P1–P10) or the decision log (§11)
labels: rfc
---

**Summary** (one line)

**Principle(s) affected** (P1–P10)

**Decision(s) affected** (D1–D16)

**Motivation** (problem being solved, who it serves)

**Proposal** (detailed)

**Alternatives considered**

**Risks & mitigations**

**Unresolved questions**
